articles.summary: We've added two new roles to the PropelAuth dashboard: Developer and Customer Management. The idea behind both is the same: give people access to everything they need for their job, without access to anything extra. In practice, the person setting up your login methods and the person helping a customer fix their SSO connection are doing pretty different things.
